clips.end_words: The real question is, what caused it
clips.send: Someone who just got a new diagnosis and is already Googling for a quick fix sends this to themselves - anxiety about chasing symptoms for years without ever asking why they got sick in the first place.
clips.caption:
On The Kevin Trudeau Show, Kevin Trudeau points out a pattern almost everyone falls into: get sick, then go straight to looking for a quick fix.

High blood pressure. Diabetes. A headache. Most people reach for a pill without ever asking why it showed up in the first place.

His point: a headache isn't there because your body ran out of Tylenol. Every symptom has a cause, and chasing a quick fix without asking what caused it only deals with the surface.

Next time something's wrong, which question do you actually ask first?
